title: Teaching
text:
Date: November 2023 | Role: Trainer
Host Organization: Ho Chi Minh City Center for Disease Control (HCDC) & Oxford University Clinical Research Unit (OUCRU)
Target Audience: Public health practitioners and staff members at HCDC (approx. 30 participants)
Topic: Systematic Review Methodology & Scientific Research

Delivered a training session on systematic review methodology and data analysis in health research for public health staff at HCDC under the strategic collaboration framework between HCDC and OUCRU.
Guided participants through the fundamentals of conducting systematic literature reviews, search strategies, and evidence synthesis.

title: Thanh Lam Nguyen
text:
Hello! I am a Master’s student in Public Health - Statistics, Modelling, and Health Data Science (SMSDS) at Sorbonne Université.
I am also an active member of MIDVIE, a Vietnamese infectious disease mathematical modelling community established through a collaboration between the Oxford University Clinical Research Unit (OUCRU) and the Ho Chi Minh City Center for Disease Control (HCDC).
When I’m not digging into data or models, you’ll probably find me at the gym, in the pool, or out training for a triathlon.

title: Thanh Lam Nguyen
text:
Research Interest
My research focuses on causal inference and mathematical modelling. My current work concentrates on causal inference methods, confounding control, and infectious disease dynamics.
